name: πToniC
author: Timo
summary: πToniC is an 8-voice drum machine for Force and MPC, inspired by Microtonic. Each voice combines noise with synth, wavetable or sample playback, plus modulation, EQ and effects. Includes 150 Patternarium BEST kits, Microtonic .mtpreset import, and matching A+B patterns in the πClideaN MIDI sequencer.
